evidence: FACT: AI accelerator demand has structurally repriced memory. Samsung Q2 2026 revenue KRW 171.5T and operating profit KRW 89.5T (OPM 52.2%) versus FY2025 full-year revenue KRW 333.61T and operating profit KRW 43.60T - a single quarter now exceeds half of the prior full year's revenue.

FACT: Samsung passed final HBM4 qualification at NVIDIA and AMD first among suppliers and began shipments in Q2 2026, securing a position on the NVIDIA Rubin platform. When customers raised the HBM4 speed requirement in Q4 2025, Samsung's part passed without redesign because it was designed at top speed.
FACT: Samsung shipped the industry's first HBM4E samples; HBM4 is expected to exceed 60% of Samsung's own HBM revenue in H2 2026.

INFERENCE: Samsung is the only company holding leading-edge memory, logic foundry and advanced packaging under one roof. As the HBM base die becomes a logic product, that vertical integration is a structural position neither SK hynix, Micron nor TSMC can replicate.
counter_evidence: FACT: Samsung lost HBM leadership entirely for roughly three product generations (HBM3/HBM3E); it is recovering a position it forfeited, not defining the category. SK hynix defined HBM.
FACT: Foundry remains a distant second to TSMC, whose Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B with 7nm-and-below at 77% of wafer revenue and a full-year growth outlook above +40%.
INFERENCE: Memory's structural expansion is driven by hyperscaler capex now exceeding hyperscaler operating cash flow, so the durability of the driver is not controlled by Samsung.
missing_data: Segment-level DS operating profit split between DRAM, NAND, HBM and foundry
Samsung's contracted HBM4 volume allocation at NVIDIA for 2027

evidence: FACT: Passing HBM4 qualification at the raised speed specification without a redesign demonstrates real engineering headroom, not merely adequate product.

INFERENCE: HBM is a hard bottleneck on accelerator performance, so memory now captures a rising share of the value of each AI system - Meta explicitly cited memory pricing when raising its 2026 capex guidance to $125-145B from $115-135B.
FACT: Qualification cycles are long and customer-specific, which creates genuine switching friction within a product generation.
counter_evidence: INFERENCE: Stickiness is qualification-based, not preference-based. It resets at each generation, which is exactly how Samsung lost HBM3E and how it is now regaining share at HBM4.
INFERENCE: Customers actively want multiple qualified suppliers in order to break memory pricing power; their revealed preference works against durable Samsung pricing power.
FACT: Memory remains a specification-driven component; end customers do not choose Samsung by brand.
missing_data: Contracted versus spot share of HBM revenue
Length and price terms of HBM4 supply agreements

evidence: FACT: HBM market share rose from 21% in Q1 2026 to 33% in Q2 2026 (Counterpoint). Direction of share, which policy/agents deep-analyst prioritises over level, is clearly positive.

FACT: SK hynix moved the opposite way - its HBM share fell from 64% a year earlier to 50% - and its HBM4 mass production slipped to Q3 2026 on interface sync issues, with capacity redirected to DDR5/LPDDR5 and full-year HBM4 shipments revised down.
FACT: Samsung foundry utilisation exceeded 80% in Q1 2026, the highest in about a year, and it won Tesla AI5 alongside TSMC; the foundry breakeven target was pulled forward from 2027 to 2026.
ESTIMATE: Samsung HBM4 yield reported around 80% (TrendForce, Aug 2026).
counter_evidence: INFERENCE: A three-player oligopoly with a state-backed Chinese entrant (CXMT) is a structurally contested market; memory moats are process-node leads, which are rented, not owned.

FACT: Sources conflict on the exact Q2 2026 HBM share. Counterpoint reports SK hynix 50% / Samsung 33%; a separate report cites Samsung 38% / SK hynix 25%, which appears to conflate a year-end target with an actual. The direction is consistent across sources; the level is not.
INFERENCE: One or two quarters of share gain during a competitor's execution stumble is not yet proof of a structurally wider moat.
missing_data: Whether Samsung's HBM4 share gain is a durable technology lead or a temporary allocation shift during SK hynix's delay
CXMT's actual leading-edge DRAM capability and timeline

evidence: FACT: Share count is falling. On 2026-04-02 Samsung cancelled 73,359,314 common and 13,603,461 preferred treasury shares (approx. KRW 14.58T), reducing common shares outstanding from 5,919,637,922 to 5,846,278,608 (-1.24%).

FACT: On 2026-08-21 the board approved a 2026 shareholder return of approximately KRW 90-110T, more than five times the previous record (KRW 20.3T in 2020), including roughly KRW 30T of cash dividend in Q3. Against a common-share market capitalisation of about KRW 1,462T that is a 6-7% one-year shareholder yield.

INFERENCE: Memory is the canonical scale-cost business, and Samsung's memory-plus-foundry-plus-packaging integration lets one R&D base open several economic opportunities (HBM4, HBM4E, base-die foundry, 2nm).
counter_evidence: FACT: Capital absorption is enormous. The value-up plan contemplates over KRW 110T of facility and R&D investment; Pyeongtaek P5 fab1 is expected to absorb KRW 60T+ with fab2 similar (2029 target); the Taylor site is a US$37B (approx. KRW 56T) commitment.

ESTIMATE: Combined 2027 capex for Samsung, SK hynix and Micron is projected at US$146B (approx. KRW 209T), roughly 3.4x the US$43B of 2024. That is the classic mechanism by which memory incremental ROIC collapses, and it is being committed now.

FACT: The separate KRW 15T buyback approved 2026-08-21 is for employee share compensation (performance incentives and performance-conditioned stock), not for cancellation. It offsets dilution rather than reducing share count, and it converts what was historically cash bonus into equity - a real change that must be tracked.
missing_data: Samsung's own 2026 and 2027 capex guidance figures
Whether the KRW 90-110T return will be delivered as dividend or as buyback-and-cancel - decided at the January 2027 board
Annual SBC expense under the new performance-conditioned stock programme

evidence: FACT: Capital returns are being executed, not merely announced - KRW 14.58T of shares were actually cancelled on 2026-04-02, and the 2026-08-21 filing is the confirmed version of a June 2026 press report that the company had previously answered only as unconfirmed.

FACT: Two long-standing operational failures are being corrected under current management: HBM competitiveness (first to pass HBM4 qualification) and foundry (utilisation above 80%, Tesla AI5, breakeven pulled forward a year).

FACT: Legal overhang resolved. On 2025-07-17 the Supreme Court confirmed the acquittal of Chairman Lee Jae-yong on all 19 charges relating to the Samsung C&T/Cheil Industries merger and Samsung Biologics accounting, ending roughly nine years of legal risk.
counter_evidence: INFERENCE: The three-generation HBM miss was itself a capital-allocation and technology-roadmap failure by the same organisation; the recovery does not erase the base rate.

INFERENCE: Buying back stock at a cyclical earnings peak, when the share price embeds peak book value, is the weakest point in the buyback cycle - repurchase price discipline is an explicit scorecard indicator and this is not evidence of it.

FACT: The multi-year return commitment is ambiguous in public reporting - a June 2026 press report described a KRW 90T buyback split over three years, while the confirmed August announcement is a KRW 90-110T return for 2026 alone with three-year totals reported at KRW 120-140T. These cannot all be right.
missing_data: Board's stated framework for the January 2027 dividend-versus-buyback decision
Any disclosed hurdle rate or return test for the KRW 110T+ investment programme

evidence: FACT (tier-1 filing): Distributable-profit headroom for treasury purchases is KRW 222,623,486,825,081, computed from separate-basis net assets of KRW 254,330,082,981,146 at the prior fiscal year end.
FACT: The KRW 110T+ investment programme and the KRW 90-110T shareholder return are being funded from operating cash flow, not external financing.
FACT: Gross margin and operating leverage are at record levels (Q2 2026 OPM 52.2%), and the group retains a diversified non-memory revenue base (MX, VD, Harman) that cushions a memory trough.
counter_evidence: INFERENCE: Survivability is not the risk here; the risk is that a fortress balance sheet is deployed into a capex race at the top of the cycle.
FACT: The KRW 254T net-asset figure is separate-basis as of the prior fiscal year end and is not the current consolidated equity position.

evidence: FACT: At the 2026-09-03 close of KRW 250,000, common-share market capitalisation is approximately KRW 1,462T (5,846,278,608 shares). Including preferred at an estimated KRW 215,000 the total equity value is approximately KRW 1,634T.

INFERENCE: Against an H1 2026 annualised operating profit run-rate of about KRW 293T, the price is roughly 7x peak earnings. The market is explicitly NOT capitalising the current peak - it already discounts a large normalisation.

INFERENCE: The required normalisation is nonetheless demanding in absolute terms. At a 12-15x normalised P/E the price requires mid-cycle operating profit of roughly KRW 145-180T, which is 2.5-3.1x the previous all-time peak of KRW 58.9T (2018).
counter_evidence: ESTIMATE: Forward price-to-book is approximately 2.3x against a 2026E BPS of KRW 109,313, versus a historical Samsung range of roughly 0.9x to 2.1x. That is at or above the top of the historical range, computed on a book value that peak earnings have themselves inflated.

CORRECTION: The 2026-09-04 screening run cited a forward P/B of about 1.4x from a broker source and used it to argue the price did not require the peak to persist. That figure is stale - it appears to reference 2025 - and is superseded here. The corrected 2.3x materially weakens that argument.
INFERENCE: Probability-weighted five-year return is approximately +11% in total (roughly +2%/yr) under the subjective weights in valuation.json, which is unattractive against a Korean risk-free rate.
missing_data: Verified preferred-share price and current consolidated net cash, both of which move the total equity value and EV materially
Company or consensus 2027 earnings estimate on a post-Q2-2026 basis

evidence: INFERENCE: Permanent-loss risk is genuinely low. With KRW 222.6T of distributable-profit headroom, a net cash position and a diversified revenue base, a bear outcome is a large price decline, not an impairment of capital.

INFERENCE: The bull case is real and specific rather than hand-waving: if AI memory is a durable regime change, Samsung's unique memory-plus-foundry-plus-packaging integration is the best-positioned asset for HBM5/HBM6.
counter_evidence: INFERENCE: This fails the outlier-magnitude test in policy/investment-philosophy.md section 4. At approximately KRW 1,634T of equity value, a 10x outcome implies a KRW 16,000T company, which is not plausible. Modelled bull upside is roughly +70% to +105% over five years.

INFERENCE: The asymmetry is therefore low-loss and moderate-upside - a duration and yield proposition, not a power-law candidate. Under this strategy's own criteria that structurally caps this category.
missing_data: None material - this is a structural arithmetic constraint, not an evidence gap
